Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observer, Serializable
public class GameController extends Object implements Observer, Serializable
The GameController class manages all aspects of a single game session, including player management, game phases, tile and card handling, disconnections, state transitions, and synchronization with client views. Implements the Observer interface to react to state changes in the Game model.

    • turnHourglass

      public void turnHourglass(String playerName)
      Handles the player's action of turning the hourglass during the ship construction phase.

      - If in TRIAL mode, the hourglass doesn't actually get turned, the game just begins.
      - In LEVEL2 mode, allows up to 3 hourglass turns.
      - The first two turns can be done freely.
      - The third turn can only be initiated by a player who has completed their ship.
      - Starts a countdown timer upon valid hourglass turn.

      Parameters:
      playerName - the name of the player turning the hourglass

    • startTimer

      public void startTimer()
      Starts a 95-second countdown timer triggered by the hourglass.

      - Increments the hourglass turn counter.
      - When the timer ends, notifies all players and, if it's the third turn, forces all remaining players to end ship construction.

    • askFirstPlayerToDraw

      public void askFirstPlayerToDraw()
      Determines the next player eligible to draw a card in the flight phase.

      - Stops the autosave mechanism.
      - Automatically forces early landing for players with no human crew.
      - If all players have landed or none are left in flight, the game is concluded.
      - Otherwise, sets the next available (connected) player to DRAW_CARD state.

      public ArrayList<Player> landPlayers()

      public void initializeDrawnCard()
      Initializes the currently drawn card by applying its effects. This method delegates the initialization logic to the drawn card, which will perform any setup needed for the card event.

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard(String playerName, VirtualView playersView)
      Draws the next card in the event deck if the player is the first in flight order. If no cards are left or all players have landed, the game is concluded. Otherwise, the drawn card is saved, announced, and the game state advances to CARD_EVENT.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the name of the player attempting to draw the card
      playersView - the view of the player drawing the card

    • notifyDrawnCard

      public void notifyDrawnCard(Card card)
      Notifies all players about a drawn card.
      Parameters:
      card - the drawn card

    • earlyLanding

      public void earlyLanding(String playerName, VirtualView playersView)
      Handles a player's decision to perform an early landing. If the current state is DRAW_CARD, the player is immediately removed from the flight. If the state is CARD_EVENT, the early landing is deferred until the event is resolved.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the name of the player requesting early landing
      playersView - the player's associated view
